name: Pallet jack (hand pallet truck)

comps.spec: Hand-pump hydraulic unit with a short cylinder, lifts 2,000–2,500 kg; holds a few hundred ml of oil
Polyurethane load rollers and steer wheels with sealed bearings
comps.loc: Fork tips and under the pump

comps.spec: Steel handle tube and formed steel fork channels, about 1.1 m long
Steel pushrods, axles and pivot pins
comps.loc: Inside the forks and at the pivots

notes: The whole jack moves a tonne by hand on flat floors. The pump unit works as a small hydraulic press.
